The '''SP-3R Excavation Droid''' was a model of [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]]-shaped [[Mining droid/Legends|Mining droid]] produced during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Some of these droids were used by [[Voontara Fa'athra]] in his operations in the [[Rust Yards]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
SP-3R Excavation Droids appear in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during Imperial Agent class mission on Hutta.
